 CE : TOF, The customer called stating that he was unable to complete a TOF on his number. The CM asked for the customer's NID and DOB; the customer provided his SNID and DOB, where the DOB matched but the last digits of the NID did not. Consequently, the CM provided incorrect information, claiming the SIM was registered with an old NID and that the old NID number is mandatory for TOF. However, as per the TOF Modality, the old NID is not needed. The CM failed to follow the proper TOF modality and delivered inaccurate information. This constitutes a Critical Error (CE).
